channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Warriors will face rival UNLV early as football schedule is released
item.description: The University of Hawaii and UNLV football teams will not have to wait long to play their rivalry game this coming season.

item.title: 2 men charged with terrorism after Islamic State-inspired bomb attack at NYC protest
item.description: NEW YORK >> Two men accused of igniting homemade bombs at a chaotic anti-Islam protest outside the New York City mayor’s mansion told police they were inspired by Islamic State, the Islamist militant group, and were charged today with federal terrorism-related crimes, according to court records.

item.title: Robbery case opened after woman, 20, shot in Pearl City
item.description: The Honolulu Police Department opened a first-degree robbery case after a 20-year-old woman was allegedly shot in Pearl City at 11:30 a.m. on Sunday.

item.title: Blaze extinguished at home for 2nd time in Aina Haina
item.description: Honolulu firefighters extinguished a home blaze early this morning in Aina Haina at the site of a previous one over the summer.

item.title: Woman allegedly shoots at Rihanna’s mansion near Beverly Hills
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> A woman fired several rounds at a mansion belonging to pop star Rihanna on Sunday, authorities in Los Angeles said.

item.title: Oil prices jump 7% on Iran war, settle at highest since 2022
item.description: NEW YORK >> Oil prices jumped about 7% today to settle at their highest since 2022, after soaring by as much as 29% during the session as Saudi Arabia and other OPEC members cut supplies during the expanding U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: Airline stocks tumble, airfares surge as Iran war pushes oil above $100
item.description: HONG KONG/FRANKFURT >> Airline stocks were hammered today, while airfares soared as the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran sent oil prices surging, sparking fears of a deep travel slump and the potential for the widespread grounding of planes.

item.title: Firefighters extinguish two-alarm blaze at Kailua home
item.description: Honolulu firefighters responded to a two-alarm home fire in a residential neighborhood of Kailua this morning.

item.title: Man sent to hospital after head-on collision in Kalaeloa
item.description: A man in his 40s is in serious condition after a head-on collision in Kalaeloa shortly after noon today.

item.title: Hawaii identifies a 3rd case of dengue on Oahu
item.description: The Hawaii Department of Health has identified another travel-related dengue case on Oahu.
